title: Dual Process Theory Probe: Does LLM Safety Use System 1 or System 2 Reasoning?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If safety is primarily System 1 (surface pattern matching), it directly explains why simple rephrasing jailbreaks work and motivates training strategies that embed safety in deliberative reasoning. The causal chain to actionable training improvements is clear.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Designing prompts at varying disguise levels and measuring refusal rates is accessible. Chain-of-thought prompting is a standard technique. No special compute needed beyond API access. Beginner-friendly experimental design.

narrow_scope.reasoning: The core experiment (vary disguise depth, measure refusal decay) is well-defined, but designing a comprehensive battery of prompts at different depths and adding the CoT comparison adds scope. Could be tightened to one harm category.
